name: Winline
verdict: Owned by a group of founders of ООО 'UK NKS'; Legalbet names Dmitry Myslivtsev as main owner and founder. Nothing found.
note: Partner of KHL club Avtomobilist (Legalbet) and listed on the club's own sponsors page (archived 8 July 2025). Other betting outlets name the largest shareholder as Andrey Myslivtsev (about 45%); the first name conflicts with Legalbet. Krasnodar shirt sponsor per its partner page; also a Zenit partner.
